package.description: A professional, easy to use feet & inch calculator

en-US.description: A professional, easy to use feet & inch calculator
en-US.longDescription:
Sprinkler Fitter Calculator (SFC) is a professional, easy to use feet & inch calculator. SFC is designed for field use by fire sprinkler fitters and professionals. Sprinkler Fitter Calculator includes:
- Feet and Inch calculator with 100 entry history list
- meter, cm, and mm support
- Fraction support, 1/8" increments
- Take out values for common fittings and valves
- Angle calculator for 90, 45, 22.5, and 11.25 degree piping offsets
- Note taker with share capability (sharing available on mobile only)
- Light and dark themes
en-US.name: Sprinkler Fitter Calculator

zh-CN.description: 一款专业、易用的英制（英尺和英寸）计算器
zh-CN.longDescription:
Sprinkler Fitter Calculator (SFC) 是一款专业、易用的英制（英尺和英寸）计算器。SFC 专为自动喷水灭火系统安装工及相关领域的专业人员设计，方便其在现场使用。Sprinkler Fitter Calculator 的功能包括：
- 英尺和英寸计算器，支持 100 条历史记录
- 支持米、厘米和毫米
- 支持分数，步长为 1/8 英寸
- 提供常用管件和阀门的扣除值
- 适用于 90、45、22.5 和 11.25 度管道偏移的角计算器
- 具有分享功能的记事本（分享功能仅限移动端）
- 浅色和深色主题界面
